public_nonduplicate_tasks.evidence: 1,500 released VQA questions with distinct image-geometry tuples; 899 released source images.

relevant_foundation_model.evidence: Intern-S1 is a named multimodal scientific foundation model with reported materials relevance; benchmark-specific MATCHA benefit is not established.

harbor.evidence: All 100 frozen tasks were scheduled through Harbor with real images; pilot transport recordings matched staged images byte-for-byte.

deepseek_binary_accuracy.evidence: 70/100 full-credit binary successes over all scheduled attempts; no missing rewards. Precommitted 98.333% Wilson and paper-cluster intervals cross the strict 70% ceiling. The expansion resumed using only the 183 not-yet-completed tasks; all 17 completed expansion attempts are retained and never rerun.

verifier_false_positive.evidence: Blind GPT-5.1/Claude corroboration supports 20/100 conservative sampled-task FPs. Wilson 95% CI [13.34%, 28.88%] and paper-group bootstrap [13%, 28%] cross 15%; no pass or fail claim.

verifier_false_negative.evidence: The judges agree on a specific rejected non-gold option for 17/100 sampled tasks. Wilson 95% CI [10.89%, 25.55%] and paper-group bootstrap [10%, 25%] cross 15%; no pass or fail claim.

audit_independence: Claude Sonnet 4.6 reviewed all 28 primary flags blind to gold, GPT outcomes and verifier outcomes. It corroborated 17 exact alternate options, independently excluded gold on three additional tasks, selected gold on seven primary flags, and left one unresolved.
